thesis: The business is exceptional (revenue +105.85% YoY, 65.2% operating margin, forward P/E 10.91), but the stock now trades on a binary, unconfirmed governance event: reports that the board may oust CEO Huang, with no company statement or 8-K, and earnings on 2026-11-17 land inside that window. The pre-market quote of 160.38 is already below the 165.89 swing low, the 163.90 52-week low and the card's 163.4 stop, the trend is down below all three moving averages, and SMH and XLK are lagging, so there is no valid long entry today. The bear's dealbreaker holds, which caps the call at Hold; any long is conditional on a reclaim of 165.89 and clarity on the CEO question.
invalidation: The conditional long idea is void if price does not reclaim and hold 165.89, if an 8-K or company statement confirms Huang's removal before the reclaim, or on a close below 156.03.
key_risks: Binary CEO-removal outcome (reported, unconfirmed); confirmation could gap the stock through every stop level
Earnings on 2026-11-17 inside the horizon, read through the governance scandal; beta 2.247 and ATR 5.0% amplify the move
Pre-market 160.38 sits below all card support levels; the technical entry zone and stop are stale
Possible regulatory or government follow-on from the reported spy link, and US-China tech-curb escalation
